title: Digital Arrest & Fake Police Video Call Fraud
summary: Scammers pose as Cyber Crime Cell or Police officers via WhatsApp video calls, claiming your ID is linked to illegal packages.
details: Victims are intimidated over live video calls by scammers wearing fake police uniforms. They are told they are under 'Digital Arrest' and coerced into transferring funds to clear their names.
tips: No official government agency or police force conducts arrests over video calls.
Disconnect the call immediately if anyone threatens legal action or isolation.
Report suspicious callers to cybercrime.gov.in or your local police station.

title: Telegram Part-Time YouTube Rating Trap
summary: Promises of ₹3,000/day for liking videos. Small initial payouts lure victims into paying high sums for fake VIP commission tasks.
details: Victims receive small payouts (₹150–₹300) for simple online tasks to build trust. They are then invited into VIP Telegram groups where they must deposit large sums to unlock high-yield tasks.
tips: Legitimate job offers never require upfront payments or deposits.
Be skeptical of unsolicited WhatsApp or Telegram job invitations.
Never transfer money to personal bank accounts for work tasks.

title: AI Family Emergency Audio Cloning
summary: Cloned voice calls mimic children or parents claiming to be in police custody or emergency rooms demanding instant funds.
details: Using 3-second voice samples scraped from social media reels, scammers generate real-time AI voice clones of family members to trick victims into wiring bail or medical money.
tips: Hang up immediately and call your relative directly on their mobile line.
Create a secret verification keyword with family members for emergencies.
Avoid transferring money under extreme pressure or panic.

title: Fake QR Code Money Transfer Fraud
summary: Buyers on online marketplaces send QR codes claiming 'scan to receive payment'—scanning actually deducts money from your account.
details: Scammers pretend to purchase items listed on classified sites. They send a QR code claiming it will transfer money to the seller, but scanning it initiates a debit transaction.
tips: UPI PINs are ONLY required to send or pay money, never to receive it.
Never scan a QR code sent by an unknown buyer.
Verify payments through your official banking app balance.

title: Electricity Bill Suspension SMS Trap
summary: Fake SMS notices warn that your power connection will be cut at 9:30 PM tonight due to unpaid bills.
details: Messages direct victims to call a fake helpline number. The scammer instructs the victim to download a remote-access app (e.g., AnyDesk) to update bill details, compromising their phone.
tips: Utility companies never send personal mobile numbers for bill payments.
Never download remote management apps at the request of an unknown caller.
Pay bills only through official utility portals or bank apps.

title: Customs & International Courier Fraud
summary: Automated IVR calls warn that an international parcel in your name was seized containing illegal drugs or passports.
details: Calls are transferred to fake customs officers who demand clearance fees or bribery payments to prevent criminal charges.
tips: Track parcels directly on official courier websites (FedEx, DHL, India Post).
Customs officials do not demand instant online bank transfers to clear packages.
